newsitem.title: USA: Herbalife names Christopher Pair COO.
newsitem.headline: Herbalife names Christopher Pair COO.

text.p: Herbalife International Inc said on Tuesday it named Christopher Pair as chief operating officer.
Pair has been with Herbalife for 11 years and most recently served as executive vice president of international and corporate administration.

Herbalife also announced the creation of a four-member executive committee consisting of Pair; Michael Rosen, executive vice president of corporate marketing; Timothy Gerrity, executive vice president and chief financial officer; and Carol Hannah, executive vice president of sales operations and distributor serices.
